articles.title: All 20 Premier League teams ranked: Which managers will be fired first? - ESPN
articles.h1: All 20 Premier League teams ranked: Which managers will be fired first?
articles.desc: The Premier League is a constant carousel of coaches being fired and hired. Who's safe and who's on the chopping block? Let's rank everyone!
lead: While we've been heading in this direction for a while, we truly entered a new era of Premier League managing this past summer.

With the corporatization of Premier League front offices, the all-powerful manager who picks the squad, scouts transfers, cuts the grass and selects the color of the table linens in the canteen has nearly become extinct. Whether this is a good thing is up for debate. Whether this is actually happening is not.

Of the league's 20 managers, only one of them has been with his current club for at least four years. Only nine have been in their current position for a year or more. And half of the current coaches haven't even had the gig for 200 days. Michael Carrick was named Manchester United's full-term manager in late May, and he's more tenured than half of the other coaches in the Premier League.

articles.title: Judging Premier League overreactions: Title race down to Arsenal and Man City? - ESPN
articles.desc: Let's overreact to last weekend's Premier League action, from Arsenal and Man City separating from the pack to the VAR controversies on everyone's minds.
lead: Despite seeing some breathtaking action in the Premier League over the past few days, it was another weekend dominated by talk of VAR and officiating. More on that later, but it was a round where Manchester City and Arsenal both got wins on the road, Hull City continued to impress, Tottenham Hotspur failed to score again and Coventry City were humbled at home.
There are plenty of takes around after the weekend, and ahead of the next batch of fixtures we look at some snap judgements before weighing up whether they are overreactions or legit takes.
Let's start with the two teams that have separated themselves at the top of the table.

articles.title: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout - ESPN
articles.h1: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.desc: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain
lead: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain of the United Arab Emirates on Tuesday.
Al Nassr has never won the tournament and was behind after 25 minutes as Houssine Rahimi opened the scoring. The Moroccan forward doubled the lead for the two-time winner just after the hour mark.
- Ronaldo calls for lifetime bans after Neves taunted by Jota chants

articles.title: Barcelona re-sign Egypt striker Abdelkarim, 'Haaland of the Nile' - ESPN
articles.h1: Barcelona re-sign Egypt striker Abdelkarim, 'Haaland of the Nile'
articles.desc: Egypt striker Hamza Abdelkarim is relishing being nicknamed the "Haaland of the Nile" after signing a new contract with Barcelona on Tuesday.
lead: Egypt striker Hamza Abdelkarim is relishing being nicknamed the "Haaland of the Nile" after signing a new contract with Barcelona on Tuesday.

Abdelkarim, 18, only joined Barça permanently in the summer but he has already been handed a new deal until 2030 after scoring four goals in preseason and drawing comparisons with Manchester City forward Erling Haaland.
The new terms include a salary bump and an increased buyout clause to keep potential suitors at arm's length, with sources telling ESPN the clause is now fixed at over €100 million ($115 million).

articles.title: Mourinho 'risked everything' with subs in Real Madrid win - ESPN
articles.h1: Mourinho 'risked everything' with subs in Real Madrid win
articles.desc: José Mourinho said Real Madrid "risked everything" after going all-out attack in a 3-2 LaLiga win at Elche on Tuesday, with substitute Carlos Espí scoring a 91st minute winner.
lead: José Mourinho said Real Madrid "risked everything" after going all-out attack in a 3-2 LaLiga win at Elche on Tuesday, with substitute Carlos Espí scoring a 91st minute winner.

Visitors Madrid were cruising at 2-0 up in the first half, with an Arda Güler free kick being touched into the net by keeper Matías Dituro and Kylian Mbappé converting Yan Diomande's cross, before two goals from Elche levelled the game late on.

Mourinho introduced forwards Espí and Endrick to make it six attack-minded players on the pitch -- the subs joining Mbappé, Jude Bellingham, Diomande and Brahim Díaz -- and his gamble paid off, with Bellingham feeding Mbappé, who crossed for Espí.

articles.title: Arsenal's Max Dowman equals Wayne Rooney record with Carabao Cup double - ESPN
articles.h1: Arsenal's Max Dowman equals Wayne Rooney record with Carabao Cup double
articles.desc: Arsenal prodigy Max Dowman joined Wayne Rooney as the only 16-year-olds to score multiple goals in a game for a Premier League club after his brace in the Carabao Cup win at Ipswich Town on Tuesday.
lead: Arsenal prodigy Max Dowman joined Wayne Rooney as the only 16-year-olds to score multiple goals in a game for a Premier League club after his brace in the Carabao Cup win at Ipswich Town on Tuesday.

Dowman made headlines last season with a goal and assist during a vital 2-0 win at home to Everton in the Gunners' Premier League title success, but after four unused substitute appearances during this campaign, he played for the under-21s on Saturday.
Three days later Dowman produced a superb individual goal seven minutes into his first appearance this term before he added another straight after halftime to propel Arsenal to a 4-2 win.

articles.title: Lionel Messi called up for Oct. 6 Argentina friendly for 'last tango' - ESPN
articles.h1: Lionel Messi called up for Oct. 6 Argentina friendly for 'last tango'
articles.desc: Despite announcing his international retirement, Lionel Messi was included Tuesday in Argentina's squad for a farewell friendly against Benin on Oct. 6.
lead: Lionel Messi has been called up to the Argentina national team to participate in the friendly against Benin on Oct. 6 at the Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires to mark his final game with La Albiceleste.
Argentina federation president Claudio Tapia confirmed the Oct. 6 match will be dedicated to Messi, giving the forward a proper send-off after he announced his retirement from international soccer.

"To all Argentina fans, I want to tell you that after a conversation with the national team head coach, Lionel Scaloni, we have decided to invite the best player in the world, our national team emblem, our captain, Lionel Andrés Messi, so he can have the goodbye he truly deserves on Oct. 6 here in Argentina," Tapia said in a video statement.

articles.title: Max Dowman: Arsenal youngster shows his class - but Gunners wary of rushing him - BBC Sport
articles.h1: 'Superstar' Dowman shows his class - but Arsenal know caution is needed
articles.desc: Max Dowman shines with two goals against Ipswich Town - but boss Mikel Arteta warns Arsenal cannot rush his development.
lead: Max Dowman is the third 16-year-old to score for Arsenal in a League Cup game
Arsenal teenager Max Dowman shone with two goals in the 4-2 Carabao Cup win over Ipswich Town - but boss Mikel Arteta warned they cannot rush his development.
The 16-year-old played 13 times last season, but has had to settle for a place on the bench so far this campaign - until now.

articles.title: EFL Cup - Reading 1-2 Brentford: Keith Andrews says VAR is stopping referees making decisions - BBC Sport
articles.h1: Let them ref the games and be humans - Andrews
articles.desc: After Brentford overcame Reading to reach the Carabao Cup fourth round, head coach Keith Andrews believes the video assistant referee (VAR) is preventing referees from making decisions in matches.
lead: Brentford are unbeaten in the Premier League this season with one win and three draws
Brentford head coach Keith Andrews believes the video assistant referee (VAR) is preventing referees from making decisions in matches.
As his Bees progressed to the Carabao Cup fourth round with a battling 2-1 win at League One side Reading, Andrews said he was not happy with the officiating.

articles.title: Manchester derby VAR error: Howard Webb really disappointed with missed offside - BBC Sport
articles.h1: VAR did not even consider if Fernandez was offside - Webb
articles.desc: Referees' chief Howard Webb has admitted that the video assistant referee (VAR) did not even consider whether Enzo Fernandez was offside for Erling Haaland's controversial winner in Sunday's Manchester derby.
lead: Refereeing decisions were 'baffling' - Rooney

Referees' chief Howard Webb has admitted that the video assistant referee (VAR) did not even consider whether Enzo Fernandez was offside for Erling Haaland's controversial winner in Sunday's Manchester derby.
Speaking on the first edition of 'Match Officials Mic'd Up' of the season, Webb said he was "really disappointed" with the error made by the VAR Matt Donohue and his assistant Blake Antrobus.

articles.title: Lionel Messi named in Argentina squad for farewell friendly against Benin - BBC Sport
articles.h1: Messi in Argentina squad for farewell friendly
articles.desc: Argentina name Lionel Messi in their squad for a friendly against Benin in October in a match which is set to be the forward's farewell to international football.
lead: Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina
Argentina have named Lionel Messi in their squad for a friendly against Benin in October in a match which is set to be the forward's farewell to international football.

Messi announced his retirement from Argentina duty in August in the wake of his country's defeat by Spain in the 2026 World Cup final and after saying he was considering his future in football following the death of his father, Jorge.

articles.title: Football gossip: Kane, Haaland, Woltemade, Branthwaite, Gibbs-White, Rodri, Raphinha - BBC Sport
articles.h1: Barcelona monitor Kane & Haaland - Wednesday's gossip
articles.desc: Barcelona are monitoring Harry Kane and Erling Haaland, Nick Woltemade could be a replacement for Kane at Bayern Munich, and Manchester United are interested in Jarrad Branthwaite, plus more.
lead: Barcelona are monitoring both Harry Kane and Erling Haaland, while Germany striker Nick Woltemade could be a replacement for Kane at Bayern Munich, and Manchester United are interested in Jarrad Branthwaite.

Barcelona are looking at England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane, 33, and Manchester City's 26-year-old Norway international Erling Haaland as alternatives to Atletico Madrid and Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, 26. (Talksport)
, external

Bayern Munich have been linked with 24-year-old Newcastle United and Germany forward Nick Woltemade - currently on loan at Juventus - as a potential replacement for Kane. (Talksport)
